name: @qu/app-kit
description: Qu V5: createQuApp() - a batteries-included convenience wrapper over @qu/bootstrap for the common case (one call: identity+transport+storage adapters by name, an optional Kind-Schema map and DOM mount for Qu-Components, an optional WebRTC peer helper). Pure composition over already-tested primitives (AdapterRegistry, bootstrapSpace(), wrapWithSignaling(), createWebRTCPeer()) - never a new capability, always an escape hatch (registry/transport/an already-built identity) back to @qu/bootstrap directly. See docs/app-developer-guide.md.
